name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump to Nominate Hung Cao as Navy Secretary
changes.summary: The announcement came amid a purge of leadership at the Pentagon and a stalling war effort against Iran.

changes.title: Iran war ramps up again amid series of resignations and firings in U.S. military
changes.summary: Strikes between the U.S. and Iran are ratcheting back up amid an important resignation in the U.S. military. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean reports.

changes.title: Iran fires on its Gulf neighbors, retaliating for U.S. strikes after a wedding was hit
changes.summary: Iran fired on U.S. allies in the Gulf early Wednesday following a night of American bombardment that Iranian officials say included a deadly strike on a wedding party.

changes.title: Bessent says China agrees Iran shouldn't have nuclear weapons
changes.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that China and the U.S. are on the same page regarding Iran having nuclear weapons. CBS News' Aaron MacLean reports.

changes.title: Iran claims U.S. struck wedding party as Trump navigates Pentagon leadership infighting
changes.summary: Iran is making fresh claims about the latest round of strikes in the region. This comes as U.S. military leaders navigate tensions sparked by resignations and recent firings. CBS News' Eleanor Watson has more.

changes.title: Iran attacks U.S. allies in Gulf region as Trump downplays peace deal potential
changes.summary: President Trump on Wednesday downplayed the importance of a peace deal with Tehran while calling on Iranian citizens to take over their government. CBS News' Weijia Jiang and Samantha Vinograd have the latest.

changes.title: Prolonged Iran war creating major dent in global economy, Cliff Kupchan says
changes.summary: To discuss the latest flare-up in the war with Iran and the impact on the global economy, Geoff Bennett spoke with Cliff Kupchan. He's chairman emeritus at the consulting company Eurasia Group and senior fellow at the think tank Center for the National Interest.

changes.title: U.S. strikes Iran again as Tehran targets American allies in Gulf region
changes.summary: Iran attacked American bases and allies across the Gulf region on Wednesday. It followed U.S. attacks along Iran's southern coast that killed at least 18, according to Iran's health minister. changes.title: Trump Returns to a Familiar Playbook as the War With Iran Flares Up Again
changes.summary: The United States seems increasingly bogged down in Iran after six months of conflict, despite President Trump’s declarations of military dominance.

changes.title: Putin Pledges Increased Strikes in Ukraine and Support for Iran
changes.summary: The Russian president promised continued retaliation against the Ukrainians and “full solidarity” with Iran.
